description: pixel art, the lower half of a gentle woman saint in pure white robes with fine golden embroidery, a golden sash and a long pale gold mantle, riding: seated astride a horse that is not drawn, seen strictly from the side and facing right; the hips sit on the saddle, the white robe falls over the near thigh which lies forward along the horse's back, from the knee the robe hangs straight down and one brown leather shoe shows below its hem, resting level in a stirrup that is not drawn; the pale gold mantle hangs down behind over the horse's back; only the near leg is seen; the same colours, outline, pixel size and shading as the upper half above, which stays as it is; nothing else: no horse, no saddle, no reins, no ground, transparent background
